notes.title: Mountain Update & 20% off Everything coupon!
notes.content:
Hi friends.

Mountain 1.01 went out yesterday and I hope you're all enjoying it! We will be keeping an eye on this and follow up with any fixes next week.

 Everything is finally out today and all Mountain owners get a 20% off coupon. This is in addition to the 20% off launch discount - so you get 40% off!

Your discount should be applied automatically at checkout. 

Thank you, as always, for giving me the opportunity to create games like this for you.

David

notes.title: Mountain update pretties up our favourite pet rock
notes.content: Back in 2014, we were all given a miniature Mountain [official site] of our own (or became mountains?). We were delighted as household items rained from the skies, days and weather passed, and our pet rock thought little thoughts. Then Graham murdered his mountain and suddenly we became hyper-aware of mortality. I took care of my own mountain for days but as its thoughts became darker and more confused, I worried its end might be near and… I have not visited it since. Well, today I met a new mountain, as creator David OReilly has launched a big update refreshing Mountain. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Mountain is getting a big update on 4/20
notes.content:
Hi friends. First thing - thank you, from the bottom of my heart, for your support of this game. The fact that anyone might even read this is the most amazing thing to me, I am very grateful for your attention in this brief time we have on the planet.

Second thing - there is a big update coming. You all deserve a big refresh and it's going to be happening on April 20th and of course it will be free. New things to look forward to:

	•	Big performance improvement
	•	Complete asset refresh - better graphics all round
	•	More varied & realistic vegetation
	•	Better Mountain shapes
	•	3X as many things can fall from space
	•	All things now have sound interaction
	•	31 Steam Achievements
	•	Steam Trading Cards, Badges, Emoticons, Profile BGs.

Third thing - I have a totally new game coming out on Friday April 21st - for Mac & PC - called Everything. You can check out the gameplay trailer here and wishlist it now here. 

Your support of Mountain made this new game possible - and you will all be getting vouchers for it (which also apply to the launch discount). The vouchers are actually worth more than the price of Mountain - I just really wanted to say thank you. You have enabled me to keep my work independent.  

If you love Mountain, Everything is a much larger exploration of the same ideas. I really worked hard on it and I hope you enjoy it. So don't forget to  wishlist it!

Thank you all again. 

David

Find me on  twitter  /  facebook
